title: Centralizers and classifying spaces for commutativity of $SL_2(\mathbb{Z}[1/p])$
summary: We compute the homotopy type of the classifying space for commutativity introduced by Adem, F. Cohen and Torres-Giese for the group $\SL_2(\Z[1/p])$, both as a discrete topological group and with the subspace topology from $\SL_2(\R)$. Doing so requires compiling detailed information on the maximal abelian subgroups of $\SL_2(\Z[1/p])$, which turn out to be precisely the centralizers of the non-central elements of the group, for which we employ methods from geometric group theory.
